en.title: Rent receipt
paragraphs: I, the undersigned {{landlord}}, landlord of the home at {{address}}, acknowledge receiving from {{tenant}} the sum of {{amount}} as rent for the period {{period}}, paid on {{paid_on}}.

This receipt is made from the payment the landlord confirmed on the platform on {{confirmed_on}}. Where rent is payable weekly, the landlord must provide a rent book or other similar document (Landlord and Tenant Act 1985, s.4).
